purpose: First dependency-ordered Factory wave for company onboarding plus early CEREBRO Gateway/Console. Scaffolds only; no PROD activation.

engines.name: Company Registry Engine
engines.objective: Register each company once with canonical identity, scope, ownership, brands, domains, geography, accesses and lifecycle state.

engines.name: Company Onboarding Orchestrator
engines.objective: Orchestrate the end-to-end new-company pipeline by events and gates without duplicating runtimes or bypassing HUMAN_REQUIRED.

engines.name: Digital Footprint Scanner
engines.objective: Discover web, subdomains, technologies, indexation, public social/local profiles, content and public brand signals with dated evidence.

engines.name: Business Model Discovery Engine
engines.objective: Discover services, products, customers, value proposition, geography, channels, objectives and critical restrictions for a company.

engines.name: Process Discovery Engine
engines.objective: Map lead-to-sale-to-operation-to-postsale processes, owners, systems, documents, handoffs and blockers before bootstrapping internal systems.

engines.name: Website Audit Engine por Empresa
engines.objective: Audit technical SEO, architecture, content, conversion, forms, tracking and website gaps per company without mutating production.

engines.name: Keyword Discovery Engine por Empresa
engines.objective: Build keyword seeds, intent, clusters, local opportunities, competition signals, target URLs and priorities per company.

engines.name: Social Media Audit Engine
engines.objective: Audit public social profiles, formats, cadence, audience signals, content coverage and gaps without publishing.

engines.name: Local Presence / Google Business Engine
engines.objective: Audit local presence, NAP, categories, services, reviews and geographic coverage; mutations require explicit access and policy gates.

engines.name: Competitor Intelligence Engine
engines.objective: Map and compare relevant competitors across search, web, local presence, social, positioning and observable offers using evidence and dates.

engines.name: Market Intelligence Engine
engines.objective: Synthesize market demand, competitor evidence, segments, opportunities, risks and trends into dated, explainable company intelligence.

engines.name: Company Knowledge Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Create the initial company knowledge package with source, date, confidence, scope and rules from validated discovery evidence.

engines.name: SEO Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate keyword-to-URL mapping, architecture, technical/content/local backlog, measurement and publishing gates for SEO-001.

engines.name: Social Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate social pillars, tone, profile requirements, formats, calendar, assets and metrics; publishing remains permission-gated.

engines.name: Marketing Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate a zero-budget-default funnel, buyer-persona hypotheses, acquisition plan and tracking from company, market, SEO and social knowledge.

engines.name: Company Engine Activation Matrix
engines.objective: Decide which engines are required, optional or not applicable for each company using sector, channels, regulation, size and risk.

engines.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation Engine
engines.objective: Enforce company isolation by default across engine context, data, knowledge, permissions, secrets and metrics without creating per-company forks.

engines.name: CRM Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate CRM pipeline, entities, states, dedupe, tasks, permissions and integration contracts without modifying the existing CRM until validated.

engines.name: App Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate company App configuration, modules, roles, navigation, endpoint contracts and feature flags in PREPROD without degrading the existing App.

engines.name: Automation Bootstrap Engine
engines.objective: Generate event/job/communication/tracking/reporting automation templates in PREPROD with idempotency and zero-polling preference.

engines.name: Company Training Bootstrap
engines.objective: Generate company-scoped vocabulary, cases, rules, datasets and evaluation hooks in LAB/PREPROD without any direct promotion to PROD.

engines.name: Company Supervisor Instance
engines.objective: Define company-scoped health, SLA, errors, cost and engine-status supervision using shared observability rather than a dedicated server.

engines.name: Company Backup/Rebuild Pack
engines.objective: Define an exportable, restorable company package covering configuration, registry bindings, knowledge references and rebuild instructions.

engines.name: Company Deployment Engine
engines.objective: Coordinate PREPROD-to-PROD company activation only after isolation, tests, rollback, backup, policy and observability gates pass.

engines.name: Conversational Gateway
engines.objective: Expose a provider-neutral conversational gateway for CEREBRO queries and commands; never bind Console directly to one AI model.

engines.name: Context Loader
engines.objective: Load authenticated company and entity context with deny-by-default cross-company isolation.

engines.name: Command Router
engines.objective: Classify incoming requests and route them to queries, orchestrators or engines without executing sensitive actions directly.

engines.name: Action Execution Gateway
engines.objective: Execute authorized actions only after policy, permission and idempotency checks; otherwise emit a canonical HUMAN_REQUIRED exception.

engines.name: CEREBRO Console V0
engines.objective: Provide the minimal direct CEREBRO interface: company/context selector, chat, result, basic engine status, history and audit through the Gateway.
